name: Omacento
author: heroesofcode
description: macOS-style press-and-hold accents for Hyprland. Hold a vowel, a popup opens at the cursor with every accented form, and a digit or arrow picks one. Ships a small fcitx5 addon with its own timer, so the hold time is a real setting and key repeat is left alone. Nine accent sets — Português, Español, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, Polski, Türkçe, Nordisk, English — ordered so the accents your language uses come first. Themed to match Omarchy.

barWidget.description: Press-and-hold accent picker: choose the accent set for your language, tune the hold time and the popup's looks, and pick which applications it stays out of.

schema.label: Accents enabled
schema.description: Turn the long-press popup off without undoing any of the setup. Right-clicking the bar icon toggles this too.

schema.label: Accent set
schema.description: Which language the accents are ordered for. Every set reaches the same characters; what changes is which ones land on 1 and 2. Portuguese puts a-tilde second on 'a'; French puts the grave first.

schema.label: Hold before the popup (ms)
schema.description: How long to hold a key before the accents appear. This is the addon's own timer and has nothing to do with your keyboard repeat settings. macOS sits near 500.

schema.label: Stack candidates vertically
schema.description: One accent per row instead of a single horizontal line.

schema.label: Popup text size
schema.description: Point size for the candidates. fcitx5's stock 10 is small next to a terminal at the same nominal size.

schema.label: Popup font family
schema.description: Leave empty to inherit the family from your terminal, so the accents match the text they replace.

schema.label: Follow the Omarchy theme
schema.description: Regenerate the fcitx5 popup theme from the current Omarchy palette whenever the theme or font changes. Turn off to keep a hand-edited theme.

schema.label: Turned off in
schema.description: Window classes where holding a key should repeat it instead of opening the popup — a game, or an application whose own key repeat fights the picker. Matched against the window class ('brave-browser'), not the process name ('brave').
